title: Building real use of trading journal not dashabord but how I think.
author: JayPhoukn
selftext:
Everyone who is willing to work with me?, I am building for the past two months a trading journal that I actually how I think, right now the main thing that is helping me is that I can upload any CSV, no broker gate, then it shows me what I need to know, not bloated and a lot of dashboard that I don’t even need, and then a quick snap screenshots that I can simply do a snap and then it goes to my app and then adding trades there, as a data where I talk to the Ai like a normal LLM style, but instead it just knows my data, no Ned to constantly upload it.

Still a lot of work to do, but I want to know if it were to help you aswell, but yeah this isn’t like some new invention etc, you can built it yourself but I simply wants to have a place where I can journal    
How I want without the whole confusing data dashboard that I don’t even need unless I want to    
Actually knows it.
